name: pi-craft
description: Pi Craft - Automated development workflows with subagents, token tracking, and provider optimization

enableSubagent.description: Enable subagent delegation (inline in current session)

enableParallelSubagent.description: Enable parallel/chain subagent execution via isolated processes. When disabled, only inline single-agent delegation is available.

enableCwdGuard.description: Restrict write/edit/bash write operations to the project working directory. Read operations are unrestricted.

enableBootstrap.description: Inject craft-bootstrap meta-rule at session start — agent checks skills before any action

enableBrainstorming.description: Enable brainstorming skill — design before code, with HARD-GATE enforcement

enableWritingPlans.description: Enable writing-plans skill — decomposing designs into bite-sized (2-5min) implementation tasks

enableTdd.description: Enable test-driven-development skill — RED-GREEN-REFACTOR iron law enforcement

enableSubagentReview.description: Enable two-stage subagent review (spec compliance + code quality) per implementation task

enableSystematicDebugging.description: Enable systematic-debugging skill — 4-phase root cause analysis before any fix

enableVerification.description: Enable verification-before-completion skill — evidence gate before claiming success

enableFinishingBranch.description: Enable finishing-a-development-branch skill — structured merge/PR/cleanup workflow

enableWorkflowSuggester.description: Enable Workflow Suggester — proactively suggests coding workflow when dev intent detected

enableSubagentWidget.description: Enable Subagent Widget — persistent TUI widget showing subagent execution progress

enableTodo.description: Enable Todo — persistent task list widget with session survival

enableTilldone.description: Enable Tilldone — strict task discipline, blocks writes until tasks defined (opt-in)

enableDamageControl.description: Enable Damage Control — YAML safety rules engine

enableCoding.description: Enable Coding Scenario — structured development workflow

rules.description: Path to YAML rules file relative to project root. Default: .pi/damage-control-rules.yaml

promptMode.description: Confirm action behavior: confirm (ask user), auto-deny (auto-block), auto-allow (auto-pass)
